rationale: I manage multiple Slack channels where customers report issues and give feedback. Every morning I used to manually scroll through all channels to catch anything urgent — this would take 20-30 minutes and I'd still miss things. This skill automates that entirely: it pulls all messages from the last 24 hours across every relevant channel, categorises them by type (bugs, feature requests, pricing concerns, escalations), and generates a clean HTML report I can open in one click. Now my morning review takes under a minute.
